subject: Logic
title: Why Hypotheticals Work
description: A quick win: understand Why Hypotheticals Work.

hook.text: What if the sun disappeared right now? Nobody wants that—but the question reveals how gravity and light travel.

buildup.text: Hypotheticals isolate one variable by removing real-world clutter. They create a clean test for a single idea.

discovery.text: They force hidden assumptions to the surface. You can't reason through a scenario without your biases showing up.

twist.text: Critics call them unrealistic. But that's the point—stripping reality down reveals the principle underneath.

climax.text: A good hypothetical doesn't need to be possible. It needs to be logically coherent and illuminating.

quiz.question: Why do hypothetical scenarios work in reasoning?
options: They isolate variables and reveal hidden assumptions
